title: Melting Clocks and Rings
description: A dark, cracked CRT monitor sits atop a black rocky mound, its screen displaying multiple melting clocks in the style of Salvador Dali. Yellow liquid pours from the screen, cascading down the mound and pooling among numerous colorful rings scattered on the ground. Smoke rises from the base and a bare branch, while colorful particles and smoke erupt upwards from the monitor against a deep red and black background.
